text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Lois is...!
Lois is... coming throughhh!!
Is she gonna pull it off in this huge showdown?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime chance!
I won't let it slip away, never, ever!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I won't let any overseas Umamusume take it! Not from Nature-san, and not from Tannhauser-san!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Today's """STRONGEST""" issss—!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce!!
Royce & Royce & Royce, baybeee!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, wheeze*...
I did it...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right, this is what I wanted to become.
Ever since I was little...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
But it was impossible, utterly impossible, so I thought
and thought and thought, took a million detours—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Even so, I'm... still right here!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's really getting fired up.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce gave a wink
meant for my eyes only, and then—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you
so much for your support today!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Please listen!
In any showdown—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The 'whims of fortune' play a part.
One cannot expect to win every single time.
However...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even if winning every race is impossible,
a truly strong Umamusume will always run a great race!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: In that sense, Nature-san, who placed 3rd three years in a row at the Arima Kinen, is truly an incredible Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: From the bottom of my heart... I respect you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~ Nature's hyping you up.
Said she respects you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
S-So that's how it was...
Thanks, Royce.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And to that amazing Nature-san—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I won today!
Isn't this just amazing?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And in the Japan Cup, no less.
A top-tier stage where the world's strongest gather.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Getting this far wasn't easy.
But through effort upon effort upon effort—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I've finally made it this far!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —It wasn't just about putting effort into running, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I murmur it softly amidst the cheers.
So it's not entirely a lie.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My winning today was half my own strength!
The other half was—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to the fans~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right!? It'd be totally boring if the mega-talented
Umamusume were the only ones winning, wouldn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (YEAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Anyone's got a shot at this, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (YEAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Even an average girl can become the "strongest" sometimes, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (YEAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The call-and-response continued.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And so, I totally showed off my "strength"
flawlessly today!
Tee-hee☆

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Pass down my name to future generations.
My name is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's Royce and Royce!!
Let's go, Ro-o-oyce!! Ro-o-oyce!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Royce!! Royce!!
Royce!! Royce!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A chant erupts.
Or rather, she started chanting for herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly, and through her own power,
Royce and Royce created the "strongest" Royce scene.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, Royce-san, Royce-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"About that speech earlier,
looking back calmly, you..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Were you using me as an excuse while praising me?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? It was purely subconscious, really.
No hard feelings, okay? Because—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I respect them!
The Osaka Hai woke me up,
and that's what's kept me pushing this far.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, fine by me. It makes sense, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still, Nature-san...
Even though we did our best today, we still...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I haven't caught up to Teio-san yet.
To that divine drama of hers.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, Teio is beloved by the heavens, after all. But still...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We're just getting started, aren't we? Both you and me.
The higher the wall, the more rewarding it is to climb over it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's both keep giving it our all from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer.
How did I look out there today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She captivated with her running, delivered results,
and drew the undivided attention of the fans with her talk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There was truth, and there was exaggeration.
Truly a masterclass in self-producing the fine line between fact and fiction."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer,
the one thing I want to convey is—"
choice_data_list: I'm glad we could create "the strongest" together.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Together... we'll be... the "strongest"...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right?!
After all, the Umamusume Royce and Royce
is a masterpiece created by you and me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep nurturing it and make it grow big.
Now then, before we plan our next moves—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: First, there's something I want to check.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's obvious, isn't it?
Fufu... It is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Here are my notes on today's audience!
As always, let's start by analyzing them.
